category.name: Mail Merge
category.preferred_workflow: Create the template in memory with DocumentBuilder, insert explicit MERGEFIELD tags (including TableStart/TableEnd for regions), prepare matching data sources (arrays, DataTable, or DataSet), assign a field-merging callback for images, execute MailMerge.Execute or MailMerge.ExecuteWithRegions as required, apply MailMergeCleanupOptions to remove unused content, and finally save the document in the desired format while validating key merged values.

strict_api_bans: Do not assume external template files exist; always generate the template programmatically.
Do not reference nonexistent APIs such as MailMerge.ImageFieldMerging or MailMerge.GetRegions.
Do not leave merge fields unresolved unless the task explicitly requires it.
canonical_patterns: Use DocumentBuilder to construct the template and insert MERGEFIELD tags with builder.InsertField("MERGEFIELD FieldName").
For simple merges call MailMerge.Execute; for region merges call MailMerge.ExecuteWithRegions after inserting TableStart and TableEnd fields.
Implement IFieldMergingCallback to handle both text and image fields, supplying image data via ImageFieldMergingArgs.ImageStream.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate that all field name arrays, DataTable columns, and DataSet tables are non-null and contain rows before invoking mail merge.
Check that ImageFieldMergingArgs.ImageStream is assigned before the merge to avoid null dereference.
Confirm that region start and end fields are present and correctly paired before executing region merges.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Mail merge throws InvalidOperationException indicating missing item names or badly formed region.
common_failure_patterns.cause: TableStart and TableEnd fields are not inserted in the same section, row, or cell, or the region name does not match the DataTable name.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Insert TableStart and TableEnd fields with identical region names inside the same table structure before executing ExecuteWithRegions.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always build the region template first, then verify the field codes using doc.Range.Fields to ensure correct pairing.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Use of obsolete or missing API members
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1061 or CS0246 for members like ImageFieldMerging, GetRegions, or MailMergeCleanupOptions.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references APIs that were renamed or removed in the current Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace obsolete calls with the supported properties: set doc.MailMerge.FieldMergingCallback, use MailMergeCleanupOptions enum, and access region metadata via doc.MailMerge.GetRegions() when available.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words 26.11.0 API reference and avoid hard-coding member names from older versions.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation errors CS1069 for Bitmap, Graphics, or ImageFormat types.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The sample attempts to use System.Drawing types, which are not included in the default .NET 9.0 runtime.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Provide image data as a byte array or stream (e.g., MemoryStream) and avoid System.Drawing classes entirely.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Use base64-encoded PNG data or file streams for images and rely on ImageFieldMergingArgs.ImageStream.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Unresolved MERGEFIELD tags remain in the output or runtime throws InvalidOperationException for missing values.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Field names in the template do not exactly match the keys or column names of the supplied data source.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Ensure that every MERGEFIELD tag name matches a column in the DataTable or an entry in the field-name array, respecting case sensitivity.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Generate the field-name list programmatically from the data source and compare it to the template before merging.

narrative.overview: Aspose.Words MailMerge enables programmatic creation of merge templates, insertion of MERGEFIELD tags, and execution of simple or region-based merges. The verified examples demonstrate building templates with DocumentBuilder, handling image fields via callbacks, and generating DOCX or PDF outputs.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with concise, authoritative guidance for implementing reliable mail-merge solutions using Aspose.Words 26.11.0, covering template construction, field insertion, region handling, image callbacks, and output validation.
validation_priorities: Verify that the merged document contains all expected field values and that region data repeats correctly.
maintenance_notes: Update the code whenever a new Aspose.Words version changes API signatures, and run the verification suite after each upgrade.
